component.name: UartX
component.summary: UART debugging and log analysis tool for firmware developers

description.p: UartX is a serial terminal for working with any device that communicates over UART. It displays incoming data in real time, highlights the lines that matter using rules you define, lets you view a filtered subset of the traffic in its own window, and can record sessions to disk.
UartX makes no assumption about how a device formats its messages. Every colour rule and every filter is defined by the user, so the same tool suits any firmware, board or module.

ul.li: Configurable baud rate, data bits, parity, stop bits and flow control
Keyword colour rules for highlighting important lines
Filter windows showing only the lines you select, with savable output
Optional session logging to plain-text files
Named configurations that persist between runs
